rules: Only deidentified queries may leave the public boundary.
Plan guidance discovery from the packaged health_analyzer/data/guidance-source-catalog.json before live inspection.
Prefer canonical publisher or registry URLs over secondary summaries.
Use Chrome only as a deidentified fallback for an official page that requires JavaScript or an existing login.
Cache only source-reviewed documents and recommendations used by an audited answer; do not mirror entire portals.
Store retrieval date, content hash, stable identifier, and native grade.
Do not infer study quality from publication type metadata alone.
Do not send raw private documents or CasePackets to public endpoints.
